description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be instrumental in fostering a supportive and professional environment for our nursing staff, driving excellence in all aspects of resident care.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, implement best practices, and ensure adherence to state and federal regulations. This is a chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and contribute to a compassionate care community. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about quality care and staff development.

This urgent opening offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a dynamic team committed to resident well-being.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Proven ability to manage, mentor, and develop nursing staff.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
